aws-s3-bucket-enable-server-side-encrypt.reason: zenobase-web serves public static assets and already uses S3 default SSE-S3 (AES256); KMS/CMK is unjustified, and declaring inline SSE would surface 3 KMS/bucket-key/CMK findings.

aws-s3-bucket-enable-replication-configu.reason: zenobase-web holds disposable static assets rebuilt and re-uploaded from CI on every deploy; cross-region replication is unwarranted.

aws-cloudfront-distribution-enable-acces.reason: Static public-asset distribution; the only sensitive routes (/oauth/callback/*, /to) are proxied to the API origin which logs them authoritatively, so edge access logging adds marginal security value.

aws-cloudfront-distribution-configure-wa.reason: OAC-locked static origin with strong CSP/security headers; the proxied API routes are covered by the backend ALB WAF, so a CloudFront WebACL adds little.
